subject: sg-miles-card
note: P4 for sg-miles-card, row legalese-2026-10: twenty-eight interpretation forks over the card documents this row encodes. Written after the modules, from their headers, by the agent that wrote them; none is a legal ruling. F-sc-ev was revised, and F-sc-recurring added, on 2026-10-22 by a later session. Most modules do not take a single reading: they return both readings as a floor and a ceiling and name the open reading through the shared Condition enum (`A reading of the text is open (see the fork register)`). F-sc-ev has been the exception since 2026-10-22: sc-smart.l4 takes one reading of it and the register keeps the other live. This row has no per-fork Interpretation record field, so the schema's `interpretation-field` materialisation was not used; `resolved-at-encode` is the nearest honest value, and `status: open` says the reading is not settled. Several forks are marked divergence `unassessed` although a module illustration shows the floor and ceiling differing; that understates what the modules show. ASSUMED, NOT RULED throughout.
